tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Deep Navy, the identity colour. Bottom navigation bar, BalanceCard ground, app icon. Pair with `on-brand` text (14.7:1 light, 10.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Raised fills ON `brand`: active nav pill, chips and dividers inside BalanceCard, pressed nav items. Never a page ground.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `brand` and `brand-hover` (≥8:1 both themes).

tokens.name: on-brand-accent
tokens.usage: Highlight text/icons on `brand` / `brand-hover`: active nav icon, positive delta on BalanceCard (8.2:1 light, 5.7:1 dark on `brand`).

tokens.name: brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and inactive nav icons/labels on `brand` (7.4:1 light, 5.2:1 dark). Not for use on `brand-hover` in dark (4.1:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Soft Blue. Fills and marks only: FAB, progress bars, chart series 1, focus border on inputs, active underline, icons. As text it is 3.7:1 on white, so use `accent-text` for words.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Blue words: links, secondary/ghost button labels, selected tab label, % on SavingsCard. 6.7:1 on `surface`, 5.5:1 on `accent-soft` (light); 9.5:1 / 7.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind `accent-text`: selected chips, tonal icon buttons, event date block, empty-state halo, menu selection.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icon colour on an `accent` fill (FAB). Light: 3.7:1, icons and 24px+ text only; dark: 7.4:1.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button, filled icon button, selected calendar day. Navy in light, bright blue in dark so it stands off the dark ground.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of `action-primary`.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Label on `action-primary` (14.7:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App/page background behind cards and lists. Screens never use pure white as ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, inputs, search bar, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, dropdown menus, active segmented tab: anything above the page in elevation.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: progress tracks, segmented tab well, neutral chips, disabled buttons, hover rows. Carries `text-primary` only (secondary text drops to 4.3:1).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headings, body, amounts. On `background`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`: ≥14:1 light, ≥13:1 dark.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, metadata, placeholders, captions. 4.8:1 on `surface`; 4.48:1 on `background` in light (the brief's exact value, a hair under AA) so keep it on cards or at 15px+ on the page ground. Dark: ≥6.1:1 everywhere.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows, legend top rule, sheet sections, quiet borders on chips and menus. Decorative, never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: text fields, select, secondary button, unchecked checkbox, sheet handle (3.6:1 light, 3.2:1 dark on `surface`).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥3:1 on `surface`, `background` and `brand` in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive fills and marks: checked task, completed progress, income icon. As text use `success-text`.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Positive words and income amounts. 5.0:1 on `surface`, 4.6:1 on `success-soft` (light).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `success-text`: income icon chip, good-delta pill, success badge.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Check mark on a `success` fill (icon only in light, 3.3:1).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution fills and marks: due-soon bars, chart series 4. Never as text on light grounds (2.1:1).

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Caution words: due-soon status, medium priority, reminder icon. 5.0:1 on `surface`, 4.5:1 on `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `warning-text`: reminder icon chip, warning badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fills and marks: delete button, error field border, notification dot, count badge.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error and negative words: field errors, overdue dates, expense amounts. 6.5:1 on `surface`, 5.3:1 on `danger-soft`.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind `danger-text`: bill reminder chip, bad-delta pill, delete dialog icon.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a `danger` fill (4.8:1 light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Income amounts (+৳). Always shown with a + sign and the income arrow, never colour alone.

tokens.name: expense
tokens.usage: Expense amounts (−৳). Always shown with a − sign; the expense icon stays neutral in lists so a page of spending does not turn red.

tokens.name: cat-event
tokens.usage: Calendar dot and tag for events.

tokens.name: cat-task
tokens.usage: Calendar dot for tasks (3.7:1 on `surface`).

tokens.name: cat-task-text
tokens.usage: Task tag label on `cat-task-soft` (4.9:1 light, 9.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: cat-task-soft
tokens.usage: Task tag fill.

tokens.name: cat-reminder
tokens.usage: Calendar dot and tag for reminders.

tokens.name: cat-bill
tokens.usage: Calendar dot and tag for bills due.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (primary metric, e.g. this month).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (comparison, e.g. last month). Navy in light, pale blue in dark.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (categories).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (categories).

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and baselines.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding, greeting on Home ("শুভ সকাল, রাহেলা").

styles.name: text-h1
styles.usage: Screen titles in the large top app bar.

styles.name: text-h2
styles.usage: Section titles, dialog and bottom-sheet titles.

styles.name: text-h3
styles.usage: Card titles: savings goal, chart, note, event.

styles.name: text-body-lg
styles.usage: Input values, task titles, menu items, primary list text needing emphasis.

styles.name: text-body
styles.usage: Default reading text: transaction titles, note bodies, dialog copy.

styles.name: text-body-sm
styles.usage: Metadata: category · time, helper text, subtitles.

styles.name: text-caption
styles.usage: Nav labels, timestamps, legend labels, small tags. Never below 12px: Bengali conjuncts (ক্ষ, ন্ত্র) blur.

styles.name: text-button
styles.usage: All button labels. Sentence verbs: "সংরক্ষণ করুন".

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Field labels, tab labels, chip labels, delta pills.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: Total balance on BalanceCard only. Tabular figures, Bengali digits, ৳ prefix, lakh grouping.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Card-level totals: income/expense cards, chart totals, amount input.

styles.name: amount-sm
styles.usage: Legend values, calendar day numbers, percentages, counts.

spacing.note: 4px base. Every gap, padding and margin is one of these nine steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips and meta rows; dot gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field, between tags, inside sheet header.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards in a list; list-row vertical padding; tight card grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin (gutter) and default card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: BalanceCard padding; horizontal padding of medium buttons; sheet side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections; dialog padding; large button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a section title after a hero block.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding; top inset of the sheet stage.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Bottom clearance above the nav bar / FAB on scrolling screens.

radius.note: Rounded, never sharp. Nested corners step down one size (card lg → inner chip md).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, menu items, segmented tabs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, icon chips (44px squares), dropdown menus, calendar cells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, FAB.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: BalanceCard, dialogs, bottom-sheet top corners, nav bar top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Search bar, chips, badges, progress tracks, nav active pill, avatars.

shadow.note: Five elevations, all soft and navy-tinted in light. Dark theme leans on surface lightness instead.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards, list groups, search bar, active segmented tab. Almost a hairline; in dark, surfaces separate by lightness.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: Floating action button only. Blue-tinted in light to read as lifted, not dirty.

tokens.name: shadow-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown menus, popovers, date pickers attached to a field.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Centered dialogs, above `scrim`.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets: shadow cast upward from the bottom edge.

size.note: Component dimensions for a 360–412dp Android width.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target: icon buttons, list rows, menu items, calendar cells.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary/secondary button height (lg) and text field height.

tokens.name: size-control-md
tokens.usage: Medium buttons (dialogs), search bar height.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: Floating action button.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon size; 20px inside fields, 16px in meta rows.
